claims.statement: Carrier partition 2 (east-node) pickup-window feed consumer stopped at 05:58 and is 47 minutes behind; slots booked against stale (yesterday's) carrier availability data
claims.limitation: None - feed lag is measured and verified

claims.statement: v18 deployment concentrates split-reservation order load to partition 2 (east); timing suggests v18 traffic surge may have triggered feed consumer failure
claims.limitation: Causal link between v18 traffic and feed failure is inferred from timing

claims.statement: Dual cascade: partition 2 feed consumer failure + v18 traffic concentration = orders booked with invalid slots against stale carrier data

next_action.rationale: Partition 2 feed is stalled and cannot recover while receiving high volume of split-reservation orders from v18. Reverting v18 (rolling back to pre-deployment allocation rules) will immediately stop new split-reservation orders from hitting partition 2, allowing its feed consumer to recover and clear backlog. This is reversible: v18 can be re-deployed after partition 2 feed is healthy and slot correction is applied. Reverts existing 186 EXC-0921 orders, which will then be re-allocated to other nodes or re-routed, unblocking them from the stale partition 2 state.
